selection.criterion: 0.5 people + 0.2 mixed + 0.3 broad validation; within each 0.6 mean(PCC,global SSIM) + 0.25 weakest of 8 + 0.15 local SSIM
selection.deployment_rule: Promote only if the preselected candidate improves the weighted held-out score (0.5 people,0.2 mixed,0.3 fresh broad) against original and matched control, and no group mean PCC/global/local SSIM drops by more than 0.003. Otherwise retain original. Paired bootstrap is descriptive, not a significance claim.

protocol.inference: one model.forward per input, no optimizer or post-forward refinement; projection-v2 internally contains six fixed learned projection layers
protocol.export: phase encoded as 8-bit PNG, decoded for CPU Fresnel propagation; peak-normalized amplitude encoded and decoded as uint8 reconstruction PNG
protocol.ssim: ssim=global population moments; local_ssim=uniform scikit-image 7x7 windows
protocol.worst: within each quartet, minimum of four planes per metric; joint additionally takes the minimum of PCC and global SSIM
protocol.p10: linear quantile of the quartet minima
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 paired quartet resamples, seed 20261107; descriptive intervals, not adjusted for repeated model comparisons or shared face identities

limitations: One training seed, adaptive experiments on small validation groups.
Portrait test has 10 quartets but only four shared identities; quartet bootstrap is descriptive.
Mixed reuses portrait/broad sources within its split; group scores are not independent cohorts.
Fresh broad is unseen prior-evaluation sources within the existing test distribution, not external data.
Candidate lowers p10 weakest PCC/global SSIM in all five groups versus original.
One forward contains six learned physical projection layers; stricter bans on unrolled iterative structure require clarification.
